name: agent-meshy-wrapper
description: Pairs the official Meshy MCP server with a skill so Claude can generate, refine, rig, animate and export 3D assets from text or images - tracking async jobs and credit cost - instead of hand-driving the Meshy API.

api_key.title: Meshy API key
api_key.description: Your Meshy API key (starts with msy_). Create one at https://www.meshy.ai/api-keys - a Pro or higher plan is required for API access. Every generation spends credits from this account.
